name: Torque converter / CVT & Epicyclic gearset (扭矩变换器 / 无级变速 / 行星齿系)
description:
English: Describes mechanisms that enable effective overall ratio variation and multi-gear implementation in automatic drivetrains. A torque converter provides smooth launch and allows some ratio variation via controlled slip; CVT provides a continuously variable ratio for seamless variation beyond fixed gear steps; an epicyclic (planetary) gearset supplies multiple gear ratios in a compact layout and is commonly paired with a torque converter in traditional automatic transmissions (AT).
中文: 说明用于自动传动系统中实现有效整体传动比变化与多档位实现的机构。扭矩变换器用于起步平顺，并可通过滑差实现一定的传动比变化；无级变速（CVT）可提供连续可变传动比，超越固定齿比的限制；行星齿系用于提供多档位并具备紧凑布局，常与扭矩变换器结合构成传统自动变速器（AT）的核心。

name: Monocoque / Unibody construction
description: Integrated body-shell (unibody/monocoque) where the bodyshell carries structural loads instead of a separate ladder frame. Typical implementations use welded stamped panels to form an exterior, load-bearing structure that improves stiffness, packaging efficiency and crash performance, enables cleaner external surfaces and more integrated profiles, and can express a unified sculptural form. Variants include mixed-material executions (e.g., steel monocoque with aluminum front/rear sections and drilled subframes) to reduce mass and influence center of gravity. Historically introduced on production cars such as the Traction Avant.

name: Independent suspension
description: Suspension in which wheel motions on one side do not directly transmit to the opposite wheel. Improves roadholding, steering and ride comfort by allowing each wheel to react independently to road inputs, helping maintain tire contact and reducing camber/tracking disturbances. Common front implementations include MacPherson, double wishbone and multi-link; frequently paired with a variety of rear layouts (e.g. four-arm rear) depending on compromise between comfort and sporty handling.

name: Forced Induction / 增压系统 (Supercharger & Turbocharger)
description: 增压系统通过在进入汽缸前压缩进气以提高进气密度，从而提升发动机功率和扭矩。主要形式有机械驱动的机械增压器（Supercharger）和由排气驱动的涡轮增压器（Turbocharger）。两者在工作原理、效率、响应性、噪声与复杂性上存在差异，但都属于强制进气技术，广泛用于提升高性能和效率。

properties.attributeName(属性名称): Forced Induction / 增压系统 (Supercharger & Turbocharger)
properties.description(描述): 增压系统通过在进入汽缸前压缩进气以提高进气密度，从而提升发动机功率和扭矩。主要形式有机械驱动的机械增压器（Supercharger）和由排气驱动的涡轮增压器（Turbocharger）。两者在工作原理、效率、响应性、噪声与复杂性上存在差异，但都属于强制进气技术，广泛用于提升高性能和效率。

subtypes(子类型).name: Supercharger (机械增压器)
subtypes(子类型).description: 由发动机曲轴等机械连接直接驱动的压气机，实时提升进气压力，响应迅速、低迟滞，但会消耗发动机部分输出功率、增加燃油消耗与成本。20世纪30年代的赛车与跑车中常见。

subtypes(子类型).name: Turbocharger (涡轮增压器)
subtypes(子类型).description: 利用发动机排气能量驱动涡轮进而带动压气机进行增压，能更有效地回收废气能量、提高功重比和热效率；通常在扭矩和燃油经济性上优于机械增压，但存在涡轮迟滞、较高的温度与复杂性。常见于柴油机并广泛用于高性能汽油机。

properties.comparison(对比与适用场景): 机械增压器：优点是响应快、低迟滞，适用于需要即时动力响应的赛车或高性能场景；缺点是占用发动机功率、增加油耗与成本。涡轮增压器：优点是利用废气能量、效率高、可改善功重比与扭矩曲线，适用于提高燃油经济性与动力的乘用车与柴油机应用；缺点是存在迟滞、热管理与结构复杂性。两者亦可组合（如双增压/串并联增压）以兼顾低速响应与高转速效率。

name: Composite body (metal‑plastic, monocoque & full composite)
description: Composite body solutions encompass hybrid metal‑plastic constructions, localized composite panels/reinforcements, monocoque or semi‑monocoque composite shells, and fully composite vehicle bodies. Common goals are significant vehicle mass reduction, increased local and global stiffness, and the ability to integrate structural load paths with exterior surfaces. Implementations also improve crash-energy management by using composite reinforcements or structural shells and enable different surface and joint expressions (e.g., visible composite seams or tailored material transitions).

variants: Metal-plastic composite body (hybrid materials, low shell mass, distinct surface/joint expression)
Composite panels and reinforcements (local stiffness increase, weight reduction, crash-supporting elements)
Monocoque / semi-monocoque composite shell (primary load paths; integration of sill, quarter and exterior surface as structural elements)
Full composite body (extensive composite application to whole vehicle/body structure)

characteristics(特征): 光泽度与反射特性（高光/低光、镜面/散射反射）
曲面连续性与过渡（平滑过渡、硬折线与棱角）
涂装与材质触感（色彩选择、金属漆/哑光/纹理涂层）
造型比例相关面态（如扁平、瘦长的大平面、强调水平感的处理）
作为风格与时代感的视觉线索（影响观者对年代与时尚度的判断）
examples(示例): 70年代风格：大面积扁平面、窄长比例、较硬的折线，强调水平感与纤细感
现代风格：通过曲面连续性与渐变过渡提升光影柔和感，结合金属或珍珠漆实现丰富反射层次
properties.designConsiderations(设计考量): 在造型设计中需统一处理表面形态与色彩策略：根据目标风格选择光泽与材质，实现与线条、比例的协调；特殊历史风格可通过面态（如扁平或硬折线）与配色重现时代感。

name: Manikins / 人体模型与数字仿真
description:
集合式的人体模型与仿真能力，涵盖：
- 统计学校正的人体模型与人体测量学模型（Statistically-correct manikins & anthropometric models），基于中位数/回归模型及最新人群调查数据，包含姿态变体并考虑世代增长容差；
- 百分位成对人体模型（Percentile-pair manikins），覆盖不同百分位尺度以反映多样体型与配对需求；
- 数字人体仿真（Digital Manikin Simulation）：基于3D数字人体模型评估姿态、运动学、力学、强度和施力分布，支持不同性别、尺寸和人群配置；
- 人体模型规范（Manikin specification）：涉及标准化与规范差异（例如 SAE 与公司内部模型规格），用于保证模型一致性与适用性。

Combined description (简明合并描述)：Provides sets of anthropometric, percentile and statistically-derived manikins plus 3D digital manikin simulation capability, and documents/specifies manikin standards (e.g. SAE vs company-specific) to support posture, motion, biomechanical and force/strength predictions across genders, sizes and populations.

name: PressureDifferenceVentilationStrategy
description:
两种基于进出气压力差的通风设计思路的合并描述：
1) 大压力差（HighPressureDifferenceEffect）：利用较大的自然压力差可驱动强劲的自然通风，但室内气流对车速和温度（尤其加热空气时）高度敏感，导致通风性能随工况波动较大。
2) 低压力差＋风扇辅助（LowPressureDifferenceStrategy）：采用较小的自然压力差并配合风扇提供主动气流，实现更可控、稳定的室内流动，降低对车速和温度的依赖，但需要额外能耗。 
权衡：高压力差策略适用于优先被动节能且外部条件可预测的场景；低压力差加风扇适用于需稳定、可控舱内环境或热效应会显著扰动自然通风的场景。

description: 描述：头灯光束轮廓及光束分布特性，涵盖切光线（cutoff）、亮区/热点（hotspot）、扩散/spread 和识别光束(signature)等要素；由光学设计（反射器/透镜几何）与配光结构决定，其角向光强分布定义了受照区域与切光特性。动态/自适应功能（adaptive headlamp pattern）通过实时定向或形状调整，提高目标照明并最小化对他车驾驶员的眩目。作用：平衡道路目标检测性能与眩光控制，影响驾驶员可视化与道路安全。

properties.attributeName(属性名称): Rocker / Sill: Low, Narrow, Hidden / Protected
properties.description(描述): Design of the vehicle rocker/sill to facilitate entry/exit and accommodate constrained openings. Includes lowering sill height to reduce step-up, reducing step-over width, tucking/hiding the rocker to increase foot passage space in tight openings, and providing protected or cleanable rocker treatments to avoid clothing staining.
benefits(优点): Reduced vertical step-up during entry/exit (easier ingress/egress)
Reduced lateral step-over width (easier to step over, less obstruction)
Increased foot passage in constrained openings (e.g., garages, tight parking) when rocker is hidden/tucked
Protected/cleanable surfaces reduce clothing soiling and maintenance
designGuidelines(设计建议): Lower sill/rocker height where structurally and packaging-wise feasible to reduce step-up.
Minimize step-over width of the sill/rocker; consider tapered or recessed profiles to ease foot passage.
Where vehicle geometry or parking constraints exist, tuck or recess the rocker to increase usable opening width/foot space.
Provide durable, replaceable, or cleanable protective cladding/treatment on the rocker to prevent clothing staining.
Ensure structural integrity, side-impact performance, corrosion protection, and door sealing are maintained when altering rocker geometry.
tradeOffs_and_considerations(权衡与注意事项): Lowering or recessing the rocker may reduce available structural section—require reinforcement or alternative load paths for side-impact and chassis stiffness.
Hidden/tucked designs may complicate manufacturing, sealing, drainage and corrosion management.
Protective cladding adds cost, potential fit/finish issues, and service/repair considerations.
Packaging constraints (battery, side-impact beams, wiring, fuel lines) may limit degree of reduction or recessing.

name: Exterior Color
description: Hue, saturation and finish of the car body used for identity, visibility and psychological effect. Hue influences perceived size and proximity (e.g. red/yellow tend to make a car appear larger/closer; blue/green tend to make it appear smaller/farther). Saturation affects conspicuity and perceived visual noise in urban environments — high saturation creates a vivid, attention-grabbing effect. Light/pastel (low-saturation) tones improve visual comfort under bright sunlight. Cultural and regional variants prescribe recommended and avoided hues; certain hues (e.g. green) can have positive cultural associations. Bright, high-value and high-saturation palettes may be used to match local aesthetic preferences.

properties.description: 组合属性：包含信号灯的可见外廓与光学元件尺寸（灯体直径/口径、深度/体积）以及与之配套的光强/照度特性的权衡与关联。用于评估在给定目标识别距离上的识别率与合规光学/光强要求，同时考虑早期包装与装配空间限制。
keyConsiderations: 可见外廓/投影轮廓（外观尺寸）
光学元件口径/直径与深度（体积/包装占用）
光强/亮度（cd）、单位面积光强与识别距离间的关系
目标识别距离与所需识别率（photometric targets）
早期包装约束（与邻近零件的间隙、安装深度）
制造与散热、成本与可装配性
measurementCriteria: 可见灯组尺寸（长/宽/高，轮廓面积）
单元光强（cd）及光强-面积比
灯组体积/安装包线（mm^3 / mm）
designImplications: 尺寸越小通常需更高的单位面积光强或更集中的光分布以保证识别率
包装受限时需在光强与尺寸间做权衡或采用特殊光学方案（如投影式光学）
早期将体积/包线纳入整车布局评估，有助于减少后期设计返工

name: Wheel-to-Body Proportion & Clearance
description: Combined attribute describing the proportion of wheel size/track relative to body dimensions and the clearance between the wheel edge and body. It affects vehicle stance and perceived athleticism (wheel-to-body proportion) and, when the gap is small, reduces wake and drag from wheel wells improving aerodynamics (tight wheel-to-body clearance).

properties.description(描述): Combined attribute describing the proportion of wheel size/track relative to body dimensions and the clearance between the wheel edge and body. It affects vehicle stance and perceived athleticism (wheel-to-body proportion) and, when the gap is small, reduces wake and drag from wheel wells improving aerodynamics (tight wheel-to-body clearance).
implications(影响): Aerodynamics: reduced wake/drag from wheel wells when clearance is tight
properties.measurement(测量方式): Expressed both as a ratio (wheel diameter or track vs. body dimensions such as height/width) and as a clearance distance (gap in mm between wheel lip and body).
properties.notes(备注): Attribute covers related but distinct concepts (size proportion and physical clearance); use appropriate sub-measurements depending on analysis (ratio for styling/stance, clearance for aerodynamic studies).

name: Seat height (seat cushion / seating reference / hip point)

properties.parameterName(参数名称): Seat height / Seating height / Hip point (cushion top or seating reference above floor/ground)
properties.rangeNotes: Merged observed ranges from sources; typical adjustable ranges commonly fall in ~300-800 mm depending on vehicle class; some source ranges target 200-500 mm or up to 950 mm for eye-point related measures.
properties.description: Vertical position of the seat cushion top or seating reference (hip point/H30) relative to vehicle floor or ground. Affects ingress/egress, perceived comfort, leg posture, visibility (eye point), interior packaging and center-of-gravity trade-offs.
properties.description(描述): 座椅坐面顶端或坐姿参考点（臀部点/H30）相对于地面或车内地板的垂直位置；影响上下车便捷性、坐姿舒适性、视野（视点高度）及内饰布局。
properties.adjustability: Often adjustable (cushion height, fore-aft and tilt combined). Seat height can be coupled with tilt or fore/aft travel to maintain occupant sight-lines in low-slung designs.
properties.measurementReference: Typically measured as cushion top above vehicle floor or ground; can also be specified as hip point (H-point/H30) or driver's eye point depending on use case.
properties.designGuidance: Use occupant percentiles to define adjustment range; set H30 and step-in height targets via adjustable cushion height. For high-seating vehicle types expect values toward upper part of merged range; for compact/sports cars expect lower values.
properties.notes: Inputs merged include explicit 'seat height', 'seat height range', 'SeatingHeight', 'Hip Point / Seat Height', 'Seat Height from Ground' and variants. Some entries referenced eye point or relative offsets; those are related but may be treated as distinct measurements when precision is required.

name: Ride height / 离地高度
description: 定义车辆参考点（如簧顶或车身参考点）到地面的垂直距离，直接影响车身姿态、离地间隙、通过性、视觉高度、整车正负气动截面与下扰流、底盘包装与 NVH。也与车身在加速/制动/转向时的俯仰/侧倾/下沉/压缩（roll/dive/squat）控制能力相关。

synonyms(同义项): Ride Height / Roll / Dive / Squat Control
properties.range(范围): 典型名义值与可调范围随车用场景与悬架系统而异；常见数值范围约 80–320 mm（即 0.08–0.32 m），最小许可值常见于 90–160 mm；系统可提供 ±20–50 mm 的调节或按应用定义（application-dependent）；具体值依车辆级别与底盘架构而定
properties.description(描述): 定义车辆参考点（如簧顶或车身参考点）到地面的垂直距离，直接影响车身姿态、离地间隙、通过性、视觉高度、整车正负气动截面与下扰流、底盘包装与 NVH。也与车身在加速/制动/转向时的俯仰/侧倾/下沉/压缩（roll/dive/squat）控制能力相关。
properties.designImplications(设计影响): 较低离地高度有利于下部气流与空气动力学效率，但会影响底盘通过性与部件包装；越野/通过性需求会提升名义离地高度；悬架结构（如麦弗逊、双横臂、整体桥）与主动/被动高度调整系统决定目标高度与可调范围。
properties.controlAndTargets(控制与目标): 可包含固定名义高度、可调高度范围及动态控制（用于维持高度与抑制 roll/dive/squat），目标值常与车系 DNA 与悬架类型共同制定。
properties.notes(备注): 将最小允许高度（MinimumRideHeight）与可调偏差（variability）同时考虑以满足气动、安全与通过性约束；单元制式与标注应统一为 mm 以便整车标定。

name: Camber change
description: Camber angle is the angle between the wheel plane and the vertical (positive when the top of the wheel leans outwards). Camber change describes the variation of that angle through suspension travel, under load or during body roll; it is critical to maintaining the tire contact patch and tuning handling. Camber gain/loss can be controlled via suspension geometry and tuning.

properties.description(描述): Camber angle is the angle between the wheel plane and the vertical (positive when the top of the wheel leans outwards). Camber change describes the variation of that angle through suspension travel, under load or during body roll; it is critical to maintaining the tire contact patch and tuning handling. Camber gain/loss can be controlled via suspension geometry and tuning.
properties.range(范围): Typical static camber angle ≈ -5° to +5° (vehicle dependent). Camber change under load typically ≈ ±1.5° (vehicle dependent). Change through travel can vary from <1° up to several degrees depending on arm length and geometry; camber curve/gain is tunable and often expressed per mm of travel or per degree of roll.
properties.description_short: Variation of wheel camber through suspension travel and roll, affecting tire contact and handling.
properties.formula(公式): α_i := C - 90 - A_i (original definition); can be converted to radians for dynamics calculations.
properties.notes(备注): Amount and sign of camber change depend on suspension geometry (control arm lengths, instant center, kinematic layout) and can be tuned per vehicle or track. Sport setups often use negative static camber; camber may increase under jounce. Camber curve (camber gain) describes rate of camber change per unit travel and may be specified in deg/mm or deg per stroke; camber response to roll may be expressed in deg per degree roll.

name: Damping Coefficient
description: Scalar parameter controlling rate of energy dissipation and damping force per relative velocity. Affects transient decay, settling time, vibration transmissibility and ride quality. Can be velocity- or frequency-sensitive, tuned via damper valving, and may be asymmetric between bump (compression) and rebound (extension). Often related to equivalent damping ratio ζ = c/(2√(m k)).

properties.range(范围): Application dependent; example values: 0.02-0.2 (fraction of critical damping ζ), 500-50,000 N·s/m; qualitative settings Low–Medium–Firm–Super-soft; rebound:bump ratio commonly ~3:1 (configurable).
properties.unit(单位): N·s/m; alternatively expressed as dimensionless ζ (fraction of critical damping) or % critical damping
properties.description: Scalar parameter controlling rate of energy dissipation and damping force per relative velocity. properties.description: Two alternative padding design targets for occupant chest area. name: Windshield Rake Angle (挡风/风挡倾角)
description: Inclination (rake) of the windshield/windscreen relative to vertical (most commonly reported) — a primary packaging and exterior-design parameter that influences aerodynamic drag (Cd), forward visibility and vertical field-of-view, greenhouse proportions, interior headroom, driver sightlines, reflection geometry and veiling glare, and overall vehicle styling.

properties.parameterName(参数名称): Windshield Rake Angle / Windscreen Rake Angle (挡风/风挡倾角)
properties.range(范围): Typical values from vertical: ~10–40° (commonly 10–35°; many sources use 10–45° as an upper practical bound). When reported from horizontal (alternate convention, WA) typical values ≈50–75° (e.g. baseline example 64° from horizontal ≈ 26° from vertical). Broad absolute bounds in datasets can span ~0–90° but practical/packaging limits are much narrower.
properties.description(描述): Inclination (rake) of the windshield/windscreen relative to vertical (most commonly reported) — a primary packaging and exterior-design parameter that influences aerodynamic drag (Cd), forward visibility and vertical field-of-view, greenhouse proportions, interior headroom, driver sightlines, reflection geometry and veiling glare, and overall vehicle styling.
properties.measurementNote(测量说明): Numeric values may be reported either from vertical (most engineering references for 'rake') or from horizontal (some conventions for 'WA'); confirm the reference when comparing values. Related but distinct sightline parameters (e.g., Up Angle / Down Angle) describe driver visual envelope through the windshield aperture and should be treated as separate parameters when precise sightline analysis is required.
properties.typicalBaseline(典型基线示例): 64° from horizontal (reported in some sources) ≈ 26° from vertical
properties.designGuidance(设计指引): Choose rake to balance aerodynamic targets, forward visibility and greenhouse proportions; visibility and regulatory/ergonomic constraints (sightlines) often set lower/upper bounds. For glare/reflection control consider curvature and rake together with instrument panel treatment.

Defines driver reach envelope and steering wheel posture; important for accommodating anthropometric percentiles and for coordination with seat adjustment and instrument cluster.

properties.parameterName(参数名称): Steering column position / reach & rake (包含位置、伸缩到位和俯仰调整)
properties.range(范围): Position (mounting distance from seat reference): 500–700 mm; Fore–aft adjustment (relative): ±50–100 mm; Telescopic reach: ~100–360 mm (design targets commonly 100–300 mm; some references 200–360 mm); Rake/tilt: adjustable approximately ±15°–30° with concept target rake 15°–45°.
properties.description(描述): Combined parameter covering steering column absolute mounting distance from seat reference, fore–aft adjustability, telescopic reach (reach to driver’s hands), and rake/tilt adjustment. Defines driver reach envelope and steering wheel posture; important for accommodating anthropometric percentiles and for coordination with seat adjustment and instrument cluster.
properties.notes(备注): Ranges shown combine multiple reference values: 500–700 mm refers to mounting distance from a seat reference point; adjustable ranges (±50–100 mm fore–aft, ~±15°–30° tilt) refer to user adjustment capability. Telescopic reach ranges vary by design intent—use 100–360 mm as overall envelope and refine per target percentiles.

description: Overall and band-limited cabin sound pressure levels affecting perceived refinement, communication and comfort. Measurements are typically reported with A-weighting and may be specified as overall or band-limited levels.

ANC/passive measures aim for low-frequency reductions on the order of ~6–12 dB (market dependent).
properties.description(描述): Overall and band-limited cabin sound pressure levels affecting perceived refinement, communication and comfort. name: Silhouette / Silhouette Proportion (轮廓/外形比例与型态)

properties.description(描述): 综合描述车舱内部可用空间与布局决策，包括净空（头部、膝部等）、踏板/控制器位置、纵向可用长度、座椅与货物布置以及可变布局（可折叠座椅、平整地板、模块化储物）。同时包含用于评价的体积比指标与在概念/早期包装阶段的优先级权重。
properties.range(范围): 按需求细分：尺寸类按车型并基于目标百分位(5th–95th)确定；纵向可用长度在底盘限制内尽量最大化；包装比值取向为最大化；优先级为定性高/低设定；布局为灵活可变。
properties.unit(单位): mm（尺寸类）、m3/m3（包装比）、priority（优先级）、布局方案（布局类）
properties.measurementGuidance(测量/使用说明): 尺寸和纵向长度以mm为单位并依据A柱位置与座椅包策略测量；包装比为可用舱/货体积与外部包络体积之比；优先级在概念阶段用于抉择造型与空间分配。
properties.notes(备注): 该实体为汇总性设计参数，包含度量型参数（尺寸、比值）与决策类参数（布局、优先级）。

name: Reach and Control Placement (Reach Zones and Distances)
description: Consolidated spatial constraints and ergonomic reach metrics for placement of controls and switches. Defines primary and secondary reach zones, minimum hemispherical reach zones centered at elbow locations (to avoid requiring gross torso movement), and maximum comfortable reach limits. Used to ensure controls are operable from seated H‑point without redistribution of posture or torso lean. Guidance references ergonomic design practice (e.g., SAE J287 for reach envelope).

properties.parameterName(参数名称): Reach and Control Placement Distances and Zones
properties.range(范围): Primary reach: 0–300 mm from primary reference (e.g., steering wheel center); Secondary reach: 300–600 mm; Typical control reach guidance: 200–450 mm; Individual reach envelope: 0–700 mm (maximum comfortable reach without torso lean); Minimum reach zone: hemispherical radius ≈ lower-arm length (typ. ≈400 mm for 5th‑percentile female); MaximumReachZone: 95th‑percentile forward reach envelope
properties.description(描述): Consolidated spatial constraints and ergonomic reach metrics for placement of controls and switches. Defines primary and secondary reach zones, minimum hemispherical reach zones centered at elbow locations (to avoid requiring gross torso movement), and maximum comfortable reach limits. Used to ensure controls are operable from seated H‑point without redistribution of posture or torso lean. Guidance references ergonomic design practice (e.g., SAE J287 for reach envelope).
properties.designGuidanceNotes: Place frequently used controls within primary reach (0–300 mm). Respect minimum hemispherical reach (short driver) for hand controls; ensure maximum reach does not require torso lean (example target <=700 mm). Consider fore-aft and vertical offsets from occupant reference; design for both left/right reach envelopes.
properties.sourcesCombinedValuesExamples: ControlReachDistance example: 200–450 mm; generic reachDistance bounds: 0–600 mm; ControlPlacementReach primary/secondary split; MinimumReachZone hemispherical radius ≈ lower‑arm length (~400 mm for 5th-percentile female); Maximum reach example target <=700 mm.

以低矮车身高度、低车顶线和纵向拉伸比例为特征，常见要素包括长引擎罩/长鼻、流线型车顶与后端收敛、外摆轮距或深轮拱以形成宽体感、以及降低迎风面积以减少阻力并提升高速稳定性。视觉效果强调运动性、空气效率与现代感；此类姿态包含若干变体（例如更俯卧的recumbent布局、更宽的wide-stance或通过平整底板实现的flat-floor低趴造型）。
Features: reduced ride height, elongated hood/bonnet, smooth uninterrupted surfaces, tapered rear, low visual center of gravity, close toe/foot-to-front-wheel proportions in side view, emphasis on low drag and dynamic, elegant/sporty appearance. / 重点：低阻力、高速稳定与运动感。

name: Body roll
description: Rotation (lean) of the sprung body about the roll axis (roll angle, φ) experienced during lateral acceleration or cornering. Body roll causes redistribution of vertical tyre loads between inner and outer wheels, influences load transfer, tyre normal loads, handling feel and understeer/oversteer balance. The perceived roll behaviour depends on roll-centre height, spring rates, anti-roll bar configuration and suspension geometry. 'Reduced body roll' denotes a smaller rotation of the sprung body under the same lateral acceleration.

name: UprightSeatingPosture
description: 一种以较高坐高和更垂直躯干/靠背取向为特征的坐姿，强调便于进出（ingress/egress）、视野与舒适性。常见于MPV、城市SUV、小型实用车及部分卡车/商用车。表现形式包括：较短的踏入高度（shorter step‑in）、更高的H‑point或H30（部分定义中H30>405 mm）、较短或直立的风挡与高舱顶（upright greenhouse），以及外观上“高/方正”的设计特征。靠背通常接近垂直（≈90°）以提高视野和便利性；在某些卡车/商用车型中也记为较挺直的靠背角度（文献中可见约12–18°的表述，测量参考不同）。若缺乏合适的腰部支撑，L5/S1受压/压缩载荷会增加；恰当的腰椎支撑可维持生理前凸（lordosis），改善舒适性与脊柱力学。

name: Safety-first design
description: Design philosophy that prioritizes occupant and pedestrian protection as a primary aesthetic and engineering theme. It emphasizes structural robustness, controlled crush zones and deformation management, intrusion minimization, integrated restraint interfaces (airbags, seatbelts), visibility management and pedestrian mitigation measures. This concept informs exterior and structural decisions—bumper and sill heights, crush space and fascia profile, side-impact reinforcements and seals—while embedding regulatory compliance, fail-safes and clear user interfaces.

Ensure legibility through appropriate font size, contrast, luminance and update rates to reduce reading time and errors and support rapid, reliable perception under varying conditions. / 优先确保车载信息可被快速理解并尽量减少精神/体力负担；通过合适的字体大小、对比度、亮度和刷新率，在不同观看距离、角度和光照条件下最大化可读性，从而减少阅读时间与错误。

name: Streamlining / 流线型
description: 以降低风阻为核心的造型与美学理念，强调连续、流畅的车身线条与单一曲面、收尖的前后部及底盘平整化，以减少空气阻力并传达速度与效率感；同时通过掩饰机械碎片化，具有运动与进步的象征性。起源于气动学研究（如Paul Jaray的试验），20世纪20—30年代兴起并在30年代成为主流设计话语，并在20世纪20—50年代广泛应用于量产车（如Chrysler Airflow、大众甲壳虫），体现组件一体化与最小迎风面积等空气动力学原则。

description: Degree to which a surface accurately represents the intended design, characterized by continuous, smooth curvature, consistent reflections and highlights, and absence of waviness, bumps, noise, or discontinuities. In automotive styling it refers to how faithfully the modeled surface conveys the designer's shape intent and visual quality. / 指表面在几何和视觉上忠实再现设计意图的程度，表现为曲率连续、平滑、反射与高光一致、无波纹、凹凸或不连续。在汽车造型中指建模表面如何准确地传达设计师的形状意图和视觉质量。

name: Personalization & Customization (个性化与定制化)
description: An aesthetic concept emphasizing user-driven personalization and customization across the vehicle lifecycle: selectable finishes, colours, materials and co-branded options; digital configurators and service-led offerings (subscription-based changes, component swaps, pricing feedback) to enable ongoing changes; modular post-purchase component systems that allow reconfiguration of interior/exterior elements, support multiple configurations on the same chassis, and extend vehicle life. 强调通过数字化配置器、服务化订阅或组件更换实现用户主导的颜色、材质、饰面和联名等个性表达，并通过模块化系统支持购买后重新配置以延长车辆生命周期，可在同一底盘上实现多种配置。

name: Usability (包含 Cleanability 与 Delightful Usability)
description:
综合强调实用性与体验性的美学目标：优先减少用户时间与操作负担，降低认知与体力负荷，限制展示信息并保持功能与界面的一致性；同时注重易清洁性与可维护性，将符合人体工程学的设计融入方向盘、控制界面等，以降低用户维护时间并提升便利性；还关注直观且令人愉悦的交互与触觉体验，通过满足期望并适度产生“惊喜”来提升用户对产品的好感。

English: A comprehensive usability-oriented aesthetic that spans functional and experiential dimensions: prioritize minimizing user time and effort, reduce cognitive and physical workload, limit displayed information, and ensure consistent integration of features and interfaces; design for ease of cleaning and serviceability and incorporate ergonomics (e.g., in wheels and controls) to reduce maintenance time; and create intuitive, pleasurable interactions and tactile experiences that meet expectations and occasionally delight users.

properties.description(描述):

Also includes considerations of structural integrity in relation to occupant packaging and glazing/forward visibility where relevant to safety and occupant protection.

name: 抽象形态 (Abstract Form)
description: 以抽象形态为核心的汽车造型理念：通过对原始意象的提炼与符号化，将面、线、体等三维几何语言抽象化，形成非具象且直觉性强的造型语言，能够跨车型复用并驱动产品系列的设计语。强调线条与曲面的演化、比例、姿态、结构及线—面关系，从整车宏观层面构建造型元素之间的逻辑，使局部服从整体，以提升审美感染力、识别度和高级感。该方法常用于早期造型流程，通过提炼意象、关键词和核心抽象形态推动造型演进，指导具有识别性和延展性的车型设计。

name: Modularity
description: A product-architecture driven design philosophy that decomposes a vehicle into self-contained, reconfigurable modules and leverages platform reuse. It enables multiple configurations and cost-efficient variant creation, supports parallel development, improves manufacturability and serviceability, and allows interior reconfiguration for people or cargo. In practice this includes modular sub-assemblies and removable/plug-in modules (e.g., lamps, wipers, HVAC, plenum) to simplify maintenance and enable configurable vehicle functions, as well as packaging strategies that can readily accommodate hybrid powertrains without major size changes.

Manufacturability and maintenance simplification (including low-volume composite bodies)
benefits: Rationalize product variety
Improve serviceability and maintenance

Increase speed to market for variants

description(描述).en: Integrates door-related ergonomic principles: controls that are perceived to belong to a door or its subcomponents should be collocated with that subcomponent to improve semantic clarity and reachability; additionally, door geometry (opening angle and hinge location) should be optimized to balance ingress/egress accessibility, head/shoulder clearance, and door-closing mechanics.

keyPoints(要点): Collocate controls with the door/subcomponent to enhance semantic clarity and reachability.
Optimize hinge position and door opening angle to balance accessibility, occupant clearance, and closing mechanics.

name: Visibility & Safety (视野与安全)
description:
Design concept that prioritizes unobstructed driver sightlines and overall vehicle conspicuity to enhance operational safety. It covers glazing and mirror layout, seating height, wiper and defroster design to keep the forward field of view clear, and lamp placement/photometrics (e.g., parking and turn lamps) to ensure visibility, conspicuity and a balanced frontal appearance. Also addresses dimensional requirements such as minimum luminous area and aperture sizes, minimizing blind spots through ergonomic packaging, and compliance with relevant standards and regulations.

以最大化驾驶员视野与行车可视性为核心的设计理念，涵盖玻璃与镜面布局、座高与人体工学、雨刮与除霜系统以保持前方视野清晰，以及灯具布置与光度学以确保显著性与外观均衡。还考虑最小发光面积/开口尺寸以减少盲区，并强调满足相关法规与标准的合规性。

name: EaseOfIngressEgress
description: Design principle that prioritizes easy and safe entry and exit for occupants. Achieved by optimizing seat geometry and materials, seat height, rocker geometry, door inner edge geometry, clearances and step-in height. Also considers the functional role of closures (doors, sliding doors, etc.) where the requirement to allow passage drives the tangent positions and the shape of openings.

properties.description: Design principle that prioritizes easy and safe entry and exit for occupants. Achieved by optimizing seat geometry and materials, seat height, rocker geometry, door inner edge geometry, clearances and step-in height. Also considers the functional role of closures (doors, sliding doors, etc.) where the requirement to allow passage drives the tangent positions and the shape of openings.
properties.description_cn: 优先保障乘员进出便利与安全的设计原则：通过优化座椅几何与材质、座椅高度、踏板/翼子板（rocker）几何、车门内缘与间隙、踏入高度等实现；同时考虑闭合件（车门、滑门等）作为通行功能对切线位置和开口形态的驱动作用。
impactAreas: closure/opening geometry (tangent positions and aperture shape)
properties.synopsis: A unified aesthetic/functional concept addressing both occupant ergonomics and the geometric/form constraints of vehicle openings to enable easier ingress and egress.

name: Aerodynamic Modernity
description: Emphasis on streamlined shapes, sloping rear and reduced frontal area; historically perceived in the 1970s–80s as a 'modern' styling approach for compact cars. name: Acoustic / Interior Quietness
description: Emphasis on low interior (and relevant exterior) noise and a refined acoustic signature to convey comfort, refinement and perceived product quality. Design aim is to minimize perceived sources of noise (e.g., intake, exhaust, powertrain and wind/road transfer), control overall cabin noise, and enhance comfort as well as the detectability of desired signals. / 强调车内（及相关外部）低噪声和精致的声学特征，以传达舒适性、精致感和产品感知品质。目标是最小化发动机进排气、传动、风噪/路噪等感知噪声，控制整体车舱噪声水平，提升舒适性并增强期望信号的可检测性。

properties.description(描述): Emphasis on low interior (and relevant exterior) noise and a refined acoustic signature to convey comfort, refinement and perceived product quality. Design aim is to minimize perceived sources of noise (e.g., intake, exhaust, powertrain and wind/road transfer), control overall cabin noise, and enhance comfort as well as the detectability of desired signals. / 强调车内（及相关外部）低噪声和精致的声学特征，以传达舒适性、精致感和产品感知品质。目标是最小化发动机进排气、传动、风噪/路噪等感知噪声，控制整体车舱噪声水平，提升舒适性并增强期望信号的可检测性。
designObjectives(设计目标): Minimize perceived interior noise across driving conditions
Create a refined, pleasant cabin acoustic signature
Reduce intake/exhaust and powertrain noise transmission into cabin
Control wind and road noise contributions
Improve occupant comfort and perceived product refinement
Maintain detectability of important acoustic signals (alerts, speech)
properties.notes(备注): 融合了“Quietness”、“Interior Quietness”、“Acoustic Quietness”和“Refined sound”等表述，覆盖内外噪声控制及声学细化两类侧重点。

name: Aerodynamic two-box

properties.description_en: Design principle focused on minimizing cost and simplifying manufacturing—driving selection of materials, processes and structures to meet target selling price and profitability. It may also involve simplifying systems (e.g., suspension and steering) to reduce manufacturing and component costs.
properties.description_zh: 以降低成本、便于制造为目标的设计理念，影响材料、工艺与结构选择，通过简化如悬挂和转向等系统来减少制造与零部件成本，以实现目标售价和盈利。

name: Ergonomics (人机工程 / Human-centred Ergonomics / Functional Ergonomics)
description: Design discipline that applies anthropometry and biomechanics to vehicle interior design to define occupant accommodation, reach, forces and clearances (including percentile- and multivariate-based limits) and validates solutions with prototypes; prioritizes ease of information acquisition and control activation to reduce driver errors and response time; emphasizes driver–vehicle coordination, visibility and operating comfort and may constrain styling to improve usability and comfort. / 以人体测量学与生物力学为基础，通过百分位与多变量数据确定乘员适配、触及范围、作用力与间隙，并通过原型验证方案；优先保证信息获取与控制操作的便捷以降低驾驶错误与反应时间；强调人—车协调、视野与操控舒适，常以约束造型提升可用性与舒适性。

properties.description(描述): Design discipline that applies anthropometry and biomechanics to vehicle interior design to define occupant accommodation, reach, forces and clearances (including percentile- and multivariate-based limits) and validates solutions with prototypes; prioritizes ease of information acquisition and control activation to reduce driver errors and response time; emphasizes driver–vehicle coordination, visibility and operating comfort and may constrain styling to improve usability and comfort. / 以人体测量学与生物力学为基础，通过百分位与多变量数据确定乘员适配、触及范围、作用力与间隙，并通过原型验证方案；优先保证信息获取与控制操作的便捷以降低驾驶错误与反应时间；强调人—车协调、视野与操控舒适，常以约束造型提升可用性与舒适性。
keyPoints(核心要点): 应用静态/动态人体测量与生物力学数据（anthropometry & biomechanics）
确定乘员适配、触及范围、作用力与间隙，采用百分位与多变量方法
通过原型验证设计的实际可用性与安全性
优先信息获取与控制激活的便利性，以减少驾驶错误和响应时间（Functional Ergonomics）
关注人—车协调、驾驶视野与操作舒适，必要时约束外观造型以提升可用性

source_properties.name: Ergonomics (人机工程 / Human-centred Ergonomics / Functional Ergonomics)

name: European Rear Lighting Compliance
description: Design concept prioritizing regulatory visibility, safety and lamp placement around the vehicle rear per European requirements (turn position, mounting limits, visibility angles, lens area, separations).

properties.description(描述): Design concept prioritizing regulatory visibility, safety and lamp placement around the vehicle rear per European requirements (turn position, mounting limits, visibility angles, lens area, separations).

name: Maneuverability (Turn circle)
description: Design priority targeting a small turning diameter to optimize urban and low-speed maneuvering. Affects packaging and layout decisions such as wheelbase, steering angle, track width and may necessitate modifications to suspension or steering components.

properties.description(描述): Design priority targeting a small turning diameter to optimize urban and low-speed maneuvering. Affects packaging and layout decisions such as wheelbase, steering angle, track width and may necessitate modifications to suspension or steering components.
properties.designImplications(设计影响): Shorter wheelbase, increased steering angle, reduced overhangs, tighter packaging of steering/suspension; potential trade-offs with ride comfort and high-speed stability.
properties.primaryUseCases(主要应用场景): Urban vehicles, city taxis, compact cars, vehicles operating in confined spaces.

name: Careful inlet/outlet aperture placement
description: Strategic placement and shaping of HVAC inlets/outlets to avoid generating self-noise and prevent engine-bay noise ingestion.

properties.description(描述): Strategic placement and shaping of HVAC inlets/outlets to avoid generating self-noise and prevent engine-bay noise ingestion.

description(描述).en: A formal and visual language that prioritizes aerodynamic efficiency, expressed through smooth, flowing surfaces, sculptural continuity and taut, athletic silhouettes to reduce drag and convey speed, efficiency and modernity. Applications include smoothing airflow, softening transitions between body elements (while sometimes retaining era-specific features like separate fenders or upright grilles), and occasionally blending with futuristic motifs.
description(描述).zh: 一种以空气动力学效率为核心的造型语言，通过流畅的曲面、雕塑般的连续性和紧致的运动轮廓来降低风阻、传达速度、效率与现代感。应用上包括改善气流、在车身单元之间采用柔和过渡（即使保留独立翼子板或直立格栅等年代特征），有时并与未来主义元素融合。

typicalFeatures(典型特征): Smooth, flowing surfaces / 流畅曲面
Continuous sculptural forms / 雕塑式连贯造型
Taut, athletic silhouette / 紧致运动轮廓
Softened transitions between panels / 面板间的柔和过渡
Emphasis on reduced aerodynamic drag / 强调降低空气阻力
Occasional fusion with futuristic details / 有时与未来主义细节融合

designIntent(设计意图).en: Communicate speed, efficiency and contemporary aesthetics by shaping forms to manage airflow and visual continuity; in retro-inspired designs, balance preservation of period cues with aerodynamic improvements.
designIntent(设计意图).zh: 通过塑形以管理气流和视觉连续性来传达速度、效率与当代美感；在复古风格中注重在保留时代特征与改善气动性能之间取得平衡。

relatedConcepts(相关概念): Aerodynamic styling / 空气动力学造型
Futurism in automotive design / 汽车设计中的未来主义

description(描述).en: An aesthetic concept that blends attributes of crossovers: combining SUV/minivan utility and higher stance with car-like efficiency, flexible seating and cargo arrangements, and robust visual cues. It targets vehicles that cross multiple market segments to balance versatility for passenger and cargo use while considering roof packaging and overall efficiency.
description(描述).zh: 一种融合式美学概念，兼顾SUV/厢式车的实用性与轿车的效率，体现为更高的离地间隙、灵活的座椅与载物布局以及坚实的视觉特征。面向跨越多个细分市场的车型，强调载人/载物的多用性，并在车顶包装与整体效率间取得平衡。

keyAttributes(关键特征): Blend of SUV/minivan utility with car-like efficiency

Balancing versatility across multiple market segments

name: Seatback / Backrest Recline (Seatback reclineability)
description: User-adjustable seatback/backrest angle affecting comfort, posture and spinal load distribution. Increasing recline shifts torso load into the backrest and can reduce L5/S1 compressive force (relative to more upright positions). The attribute covers typical passenger-car and sport-car preferences and the interaction with seat reference height (H30).

Early implementations were pioneered by manufacturers such as Panhard-Levassor.

name: Sportiness
description: 总体“运动感”美学，涵盖两类表现：一是以操控感与驾驶反馈为核心的运动感（通过踏板与转向调校、操控反馈、性能化视觉细节传达动态驾驶感受）；二是越野/粗犷型的运动感（通过加高车身姿态、宽阔轮眉、暴露护板与功能性细节，呈现更高、更稳健的视觉效果）。融合后的概念用于指导造型与细节取向，使车辆在驾驶感与视觉语言上达到期望的运动化诉求。

name: Safety-first (以安全为先)
description: A holistic design theme that prioritizes occupant protection and accident prevention across vehicle form, structure, systems and human–machine interaction. Emphasizes active safety (visible, reassuring ADAS and avoidance systems), passive safety (crash energy management, defined crush zones, reinforced survival cell and interior structural integration), containment of hazardous/high-energy components away from occupants (firewalls, isolation of batteries/fuel systems), and information/interaction design that minimizes driver distraction through legible displays, essential warnings and reduced eyes-off-road demands.

name: Proportional Design
description:
An overarching aesthetic concept that defines vehicle proportions and visual balance through packaging and side elevation, benchmarking and sizing studies (proportion-led design), wheel/tire sizing that harmonizes with body proportions (proportional styling), and the use of specific numeric ratios (e.g., golden ratio 0.618, 1:√2, 1:√3, 1:2, 1:3) to guide visual harmony. While numeric ratios and proportional rules guide design, styling decisions may sometimes override purely functional choices.

一种贯穿整体造型的美学原则：通过整车包装与侧面比例确定基本视觉姿态（比例主导设计）、通过车轮/轮胎尺寸与车身比例的协调实现造型和谐（比例化造型），并运用黄金比例、整数比等数值比例（如0.618、1:√2、1:√3、1:2、1:3）来提升均衡感。尽管数值与比例为造型提供指导，但造型决策在个别情况下可能优先于纯功能性选择。

Aims to deliver both physical and psychological comfort while ensuring safety.

name: Tyre Design Attributes (Low Rolling Resistance / Narrow / Low-profile)
description: 集合了与轮胎设计相关的若干属性：低滚阻轮胎、相对较窄的轮胎和低扁平比轮胎。低滚阻轮胎通过专用胶料配方与结构（例如可能含硅基添加剂）来减少滚动损失，从而提高能效。相对较窄的轮胎接地面积小、滚阻低但牵引力和抓地力受限。低扁平比轮胎侧壁高度降低，减少侧壁变形，允许更大直径车轮，改变外观，并影响操控性与舒适性。

properties.description(描述): 集合了与轮胎设计相关的若干属性：低滚阻轮胎、相对较窄的轮胎和低扁平比轮胎。低滚阻轮胎通过专用胶料配方与结构（例如可能含硅基添加剂）来减少滚动损失，从而提高能效。相对较窄的轮胎接地面积小、滚阻低但牵引力和抓地力受限。低扁平比轮胎侧壁高度降低，减少侧壁变形，允许更大直径车轮，改变外观，并影响操控性与舒适性。
properties.effectsOnPerformance(对性能的影响): 低滚阻：降低能量损失，提高燃油/续航效率；窄胎：进一步降低滚阻但可能降低横向与起步牵引力；低扁平比：减少侧壁变形、提升转向响应和外观，但可能增加路面振动、降低乘坐舒适性。
properties.typicalDesignFeatures(典型设计特征): 低滚阻：专用配方胶料、胎体与胎面结构优化（可能含硅基/硅烷类添加剂）；窄胎：较窄胎面宽度；低扁平比：较低的侧壁高度、配套更大直径轮圈。
properties.tradeOffs(权衡): 效率与牵引力之间的权衡（窄胎与低滚阻有利于效率但可能牺牲抓地力）；操控与舒适之间的权衡（低扁平比提升操控响应但降低乘坐舒适性）。
